notes.title: Target practice is now in!
notes.content:
Another mini game has been added to Froggies at the Zoo! This time you can practice your food throwing abilities. Head on down to the extra bits section to try it out. Got one more mini game to be added in when it's finished and then it'll be three extra levels afterwards. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532122/cf238575b43668fa6d03cbee2c3bb86b1b6df880.png[/img]

notes.title: Fishing has arrived
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532122/fcc0048f1f3a2948393e691c425999afc9f4dce7.png[/img]

Howdy got a fresh new update for Froggies at the Zoo! There is now a new section on the main menu called "Extra Bits." I'm using this to add in some mini games and extra levels into the game! The first mini game to come out is a fishing one. Feel free to check it out now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532122/b76839f2843b17f5baddae3fe6157d5d7602e9c9.png[/img]

Patch notes: 
- Added in a new fishing mini game in the "Extra Bits" section of the main menu
- Fixed an issue with the day/night selector not working correctly with controllers
- Fixed an issue with the controller prompts not appearing correctly on the main menu settings
- Fixed an issue with some of the intro texts not appearing correctly
- Frogs

notes.title: Some small fixes
notes.content:
Howdy! Just doing a small update containing a few fixes that slipped through the cracks. The next update will include a fun little fishing mini game so stay tuned for that in the next month or so. Thanks for playing! 

Patch notes:
- Journal back buttons were not correctly displaying the previous page
- Journal back buttons didn't have the correct controller settings
- The credits screen text has been updated to include what button is needed to skip them
- Some ground work for a small mini game has been added (you can find it but it's not done yet!)
- Couple of the frogs values were incorrectly rewarding points so these were adjusted
- Some of the kart speed values were updated to flow better in levels

notes.title: Froggies at the Zoo is out now!
notes.content:
Froggies at the Zoo is officially out now! I hope everyone enjoys the game and feel free to leave us some feedback!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532122/2a6ca17e4466d06da31942f1f2055d01a781d565.png[/img]

notes.title: Release date is tomorrow!
notes.content:
Howdy! The release date is looming and with that comes some more work on the demo. This new demo build is linking the demo save file to the main game save file so progress can transfer over. Please note that this doesn't include the photos just progress and various unlocks. 

Patch notes:
- Some more performance increases within the game
- Redone occlusion data so it is now more accurate
- Around 20 new tracks have been added into the soundtrack
- Misc audio has been added around the levels
- The journal now has some new icons
- Some of the lighting data has been changed to make the game more vibrant 
- Demo saves now cross over to the main game (this doesn't include the photos currently)
- Frog

notes.title: Demo update PLUS release date!
notes.content:
Howdy! Froggies at the Zoo is slowly creeping up towards it's release date. The game is currently feature complete with all the levels added in so it's just time to dunk some more polish on the rest of the game! It's been a fun project but it has to be released at some point otherwise what's the point?!

The dreaded release date will be the 4/2/2025. (4th of February to avoid confusion!) 

Patch notes: 
- Added in some changes to the post rendering to make things a lil more vibrant
- Fixed an issue with the post rendering not being correctly applied to the photos
- Changed some of the filter values on the camera
- Fixed some issues with the first time rewards not setting correctly 
- Some small performance gains added as well 
- Fixed an issue with photos not displaying correctly when saved for the first time
- The journal is now controlled with a mouse rather than keyboard inputs (just flows a lot nicer)
- Selecting the back button in the journal now returns you to the previous page rather than the first
- Frogs

notes.title: Got a few updates for the demo build!
notes.content:
Got a few updates for the demo build! 

Patch notes:
- Added in a time of day selector so you can pick if you want morning, afternoon or evening scenes for the different levels. (The game defaults to the current time when picking what scene to display if no time of day is selected.)
- Added in an easter egg if any of the photos get deleted 
- Some checks have been added around the save and load system to fix some edge cases
- Quick tidy up around some old code
- Steam page got an update with some fancy new screenshots/description 
- As usual frogs

notes.title: Few updates to the demo
notes.content:
Just added in some new quality of life features to the demo and an alternative way to complete the first level.

Patch notes:
- Main menu overhaul with new models added to make it more appealing 
- Some of the weather effects were turned off to help with ram usage
- New pathway for level one (you gotta give the obelisk some food to unlock the new pathway)
- Added some new sounds to add some more interest to the levels
- Reward pop up has been improved
- First time tutorial has been moved closer to the player so it fires off correctly 
- Tutorial is added to the main menu press T to see it again
- Camera mod shop is easier to read and navigate
- The journal has been updated to make it flow better
- Added some missing translations

notes.title: Big update to the demo (read all about it here!)
notes.content:
Got a big update for the demo. Loads of new stuff has been added in to make the two demo levels more varied plus lots of quality of life features!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44532122/aec894f8879ad5e7ce2adc5df4c68a7d0ddf9318.gif[/img]

Patch notes: 
- New tutorial has been added into the game (it really is a lot better!) Selecting T or Y on the main menu will load it.
- New detection system for the frogs so you can easily understand which ones you've snapped before
- New weather system (I like the rain personally)
- New pause menu 
- Camera mod shop rework so everything is laid out much prettier 
- New UI sprites sprinkled around the game
- New random spawns for the frogs in the levels
- Some small tweaks to the day night system
- If you annoy the frogs they will throw food at you temporarily blinding the player
- New kart dashboard 
- First two levels have more detail now 
- Fixed a bug with closing down the photos in the photo book
- Fixed a bug with certain UI elements not having translations
- Fixed a bug with the pause menu not stopping the kart







- Psst more stuff to come in the full release so wishlist today!

notes.title: More quality of life features added to the demo
notes.content:
Added in some more quality of life features to the demo. You can now equip rewards on the pop up screen instead of going into the camera mod shop and the UI is highlighted in green to show which option you have selected.

Patch notes:
- Can equip rewards on the pop up screen
- Currently selected UI will turn green to show which screen you are currently on
- Make a couple of performance tweaks

notes.title: Small fixes to the demo
notes.content:
Some small fixes to the demo. The tutorial will now start after the slides are finished and the controller icons are cleaned up.

Patch notes: 
- The kart now starts moving after the tutorial without any user input (this can be avoided with pressing space bar/a on the controller to start the kart early
- Controller icons look nicer
- Fixed a few typos

notes.title: Steam Next Fest update!
notes.content:
New update to celebrate being apart of the Steam Next Fest event! The new karts are now in the game and a few more quality of life fixes have been added.

Patch notes:
- You now have three selectable karts which are unlocked when you get a three star run on a level
- You can now take a close look on your journal photos by selecting them
- When a reward is unlocked a pop up will appear on the main menu now
- The game now tracks which frogs have been found in the levels 
- Some other smaller changes

notes.title: The new day and night update is out now for the demo!
notes.content:
The new day and night update is out now for the demo! The game now has a real time day and night cycle. This means if you play the game during the morning you will have different lighting and some new frogs. 

The current times of day are:
Morning: 4AM - 12PM
Afternoon: 12PM - 9PM
Evening: 9PM - 4AM

The games soundtrack also got an update which means there are now 32 tracks in total. You can skip the songs at anytime with either the arrow keys or the controller bumper buttons.

Few major fixes have made it into this build which will be detailed in the patch notes.

Patch notes:
- Day and night cycle added into the game
- Fixed an error with photos not saving correctly when using a controller for the first time
- Fixed the pop up photo displaying the wrong filter if it's been applied
- Fixed the Polaroid camera pop up photo
- Added a timer when taking camera shots to prevent accidental photos
- Added a clock to the main menu
- Added some new animations to the frogs in the main menu
- Changed some of the journal photos so the images are bigger
- The game now has 32 different tracks which you can switch through either with your arrow keys or the controller bumper buttons

notes.title: New year new update
notes.content:
Patch notes:

notes.title: Controller support is live now!
notes.content:
Controller support is live now! This feature has just been added to the demo build on Steam. No longer are you confined to using a keyboard and mouse. 

(The demo version also works very well on the Steam Deck!)

Patch notes:
- Added controller support for xbox controllers (it's also runs pretty good on the Steam Deck)
- Fixed a minor issue with physics not calculating correctly
- Overhauled the tutorial to be more streamlined
- Added in a star rating system above the levels on the main menu
- Added in controller icons 
- Updated some of the translations 
- Fixed a UI scaling issue on smaller resolutions
- Made some of the text bigger for readability 
- Additional miscellaneous fixes for performance gains

notes.title: Small update to the demo
notes.content:
Patch notes:
- Migrated over to a new input system for future controller support (this will be included in the next build)

notes.title: Big update to the demo!
notes.content:
Big update to the demo! (You can play this build today how great is that!?)

Got two big updates to the demo. The most obvious one is the new localization's! This is a rough first draft which will be expanded upon for the games release. 

The other big update is the new photo album! You can look back on past mistakes and even download the photo's (if you know where to look.)

I have a few more things planned for the demo so expect more future updates! Hopefully controller support will be the next thing added into the game.

The full list of languages added:
- French added
- Spanish added
- Dutch added
- German added
- Italian added
- Portuguese

notes.title: Froggies at the Zoo demo is out now!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44532122/aec894f8879ad5e7ce2adc5df4c68a7d0ddf9318.gif[/img]
Howdy! Froggies at the Zoo demo is out now! I'm really excited to show off the current progress and if you find any bugs or want to leave some feedback please do! The demo has the first two levels of the game so get out there with your camera and get some pictures. Stay froggy.
